item.title: fix(agents): make file reads safe and explicit (#121508)
item.summary: fix(agents): make file reads safe and explicit (#121508) Use fs-safe 0.5.4 for nonblocking, descriptor-validated reads. Resolve one unambiguous Unicode-equivalent path and return explicit empty/EOF results. Default local reads now reject final symlinks and special files. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
